marker.step_source:
import os
import subprocess
import sys

from sase.vcs_provider import get_vcs_provider

checkout_target = {{ setup.checkout_target | tojson }}
project_name = {{ setup.project_name | tojson }}
gh_ref = {{ gh_ref | tojson }}

provider = get_vcs_provider(os.getcwd())

# Checkout the PR branch so that subsequent diffs are relative to the
# PR tip rather than the default branch. Try checkout_target first
# (works for default-branch refs like origin/main), then fall back to
# Patch name -> branch name conversion.
is_patch = checkout_target == f"origin/{gh_ref}"
ok, err = provider.checkout(checkout_target, os.getcwd())
if not ok:
    if is_patch:
        # Patch ref — resolve name to branch name
        resolved = provider.resolve_revision(
            gh_ref, project_name, os.getcwd()
        )
        ok, err = provider.checkout(resolved, os.getcwd())
    else:
        # Project/repo ref — try common default branch names
        for fallback in ["master", "main"]:
            ok, err = provider.checkout(fallback, os.getcwd())
            if ok:
                break
    if not ok:
        print(
            f"Warning: checkout failed: {err}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

# Sync with remote after checkout
subprocess.run(
    ["git", "pull", "--rebase", "--quiet"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)

# Record HEAD for the diff step
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)
head = result.stdout.strip() if result.returncode == 0 else ""
print(f"head_before={head}")
print("success=true")

marker.step_source:
head_before="{{ checkout.head_before }}"
if [ -z "$head_before" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
head_now=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
diff_dir="${SASE_TMPDIR:-${SASE_HOME:-$HOME/.sase}/tmp}/gh-diffs"
mkdir -p "$diff_dir"
diff_file=$(mktemp "$diff_dir/sase-gh-XXXXXX.diff")
if [ "$head_now" != "$head_before" ]; then
  # Commits were made — show only the last commit's diff
  git diff HEAD~1 HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  commit_msg=$(git log -1 --format='%s' HEAD)
  echo "meta_commit_message=$commit_msg"
else
  # No commits — show uncommitted changes
  git diff HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z 2>/dev/null \
    | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
        git diff --no-index /dev/null "$f" 2>/dev/null
      done >> "$diff_file"
fi
if [ -s "$diff_file" ]; then
  echo "diff_path=$diff_file"
else
  rm -f "$diff_file"
fi

# Stash any uncommitted changes (including untracked files)
if ! git diff --quiet HEAD 2>/dev/null || [ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]; then
  git stash push --include-untracked -m "gh-workflow-$(date +%s)" --quiet
  echo "stashed=true"
else
  echo "stashed=false"
fi
git fetch origin --quiet 2>&1 || true
git pull --rebase --quiet 2>/dev/null || true
echo "success=true"

from sase_github.scripts.gh_setup import main
main(
    gh_ref={{ gh_ref | tojson }},
    n={{ n | tojson }},
    release={{ release | tojson }},
    workflow_label={{ workflow_label | tojson }},
)

output._raw:
Bead `sase-1t3.11.1.3` is closed.

**What changed.** Touch and legacy-view queries moved into Rust and return only the rows the context's ordered members claim — no full-project snapshots remain.

- `sase-core`: new `bead/touch_member_query.rs` (member-targeted index query with selective decode + streaming views fold, reusing `globalize_owned_agent_name`), new `bead_touch_member_query` / `bead_view_member_query` bindings, plus a one-token clippy-drift fix in `audit_query.rs` proven failing on the untouched base.
- `sase`: loader rewritten around identity-keyed (`dev/ino/mtime/size`) result caches with stat-before-query; `bead_views.py` trimmed to path helpers; deleted the orphaned `query_touch_index`, `views_to_touches`, `view_touches_for_agent`, `read_bead_view_events`; CLI `touched` routed through the targeted queries with unchanged semantics.
- Owner hunt found two retainers: `_bead_touches_snapshot_cache` (miscounted by the census, which reads `events` on an entry holding `touches`) and `_bead_views_snapshot_cache` (never probed). Both removed; 20k unrelated touches + 5k views now leave exactly 1 `BeadTouch` alive (cold 102 ms, warm 0.2 ms).

**Verification.** `sase tool run check`: all lint gates green, scoped tests green except two KNOWN pre-existing failures (recorded as `PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP`, multi-agent witnesses predate this work). `sase-core` `sase tool run check`: green. 135 touched-area tests pass against the locally built core. `epic-symbols` clean.

**Handoff.** Both repos are changed and uncommitted: commit `sase-core` first, ratchet `sase-core-revision.txt` past the core commit, then commit `sase` — I left the pin untouched per the land flow.

Declaration accepted for bead `sase-1t3.11.1.3`: primary repo closes the bead, `sase-core` keeps. Host commits after this turn.
